scripts.dev:be: uv run --project apps/backend python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/backend --reload --reload-dir apps/backend/app --port 8000
scripts.test:be: uv run --project apps/backend python -m pytest apps/backend/tests
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project apps/backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @nexusagent/contracts generate && vp fmt packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
